product: A Chrome extension that measures digital habits (streaming, AI prompts, browsing), shows the estimated CO2 and water they cause as ranges, and points people to offsetting. For v0 only its frontend screens are built, as web pages with sample data and no backend.
market: Global, English-language, Chrome Web Store, used on a desktop computer
flows_asked: F1 Sign up and onboarding, F2 Check my metrics, F3 Offset my impact, F4 Leaderboard, F5 Settings

admired.why: Sign in, then a dashboard with side navigation, range tabs, KPI cards, an offset banner, projects and account pages
Breakdown by activity category, tips, and a leaderboard with tabs and a podium
Offset by choosing an amount and a project type, with a live CO2 conversion
Compact tabs (Overview, Analytics, Settings, Offset); per-site activity and pause tracking

admired_note: The owner invited research into more products beyond these.
manual_today: Most people never check; a few type numbers from memory into one-off web carbon calculators

roles.value: Person who installs Ecobex (the only role; no admin or team)

goals.value: Create an account and set up Ecobex, then land on the dashboard
See the CO2 and water of their digital habits as ranges, by category and over time
Find ways to offset, seeing provider, price per tonne and standard before leaving for the provider's site
Compare their week-on-week change with others on a leaderboard they choose to join
Change what is tracked, their goal, profile and visibility; pause tracking; clear data and sign out

constraints.value: Frontend only: no backend, database or server
Sample usage only, no real tracking; labelled as sample
Sign-up asks for name and email, no password; saved in localStorage with a comment saying it is a demo
Every number is an estimate (range and central value) traceable to factors.js; water beside CO2 only where sourced; method one tap away
Offset: show provider, price per tonne and standard before leaving; only link out; no payments
Habits without a figure (video calls; streaming water) are listed as 'not estimated yet' with no number
Available components lack modal, toast, empty state and sidebar navigation; side navigation must be added
No manual entry of habits anywhere in the flows

decisions.value: Usage is tracked automatically by the extension; nobody types habits into a calculator. In v0 the screens show sample usage standing in for what the extension will measure. The existing Calculator and Results pages retire.
Sign-up first, then onboarding, then dashboard
decisions.conflicts_with: CLAUDE.md:6, 47, 55-56 and PLAN.md:73 (no account needed to see value; no accounts in v0)

decisions.value: Side navigation: Metrics, Offset, Leaderboard, Settings
Onboarding: Back on every step, Skip on Your goal and Pin Ecobex, answers saved as they go
Leaderboard ranks % change against each person's own last week; opt-in with a nickname; sample players in v0
Settings: habits and goal, profile and leaderboard visibility, pause tracking, clear data and sign out
First visit shows sample data labelled 'sample', no % change until there is a previous week; ranges Today, 7 days, 30 days
Offset provider shown as an 'example' card until one is chosen

open.question: What does finishing 'Offset my impact' mean: picking an amount, choosing a project, or seeing plans, before linking out? The owner wants to plan this from the research.
Sign-up first conflicts with the confirmed proposition 'no account needed to see value'. Keep sign-up first and update the proposition, or revisit?
Which verified offset provider, price per tonne and standard?

out_of_scope.item: How we calculate, Reduce my footprint, Weekly recap and share
Payments and buying offsets in Ecobex
out_of_scope.why: Offset only links out to a verified provider
